page.layout: One block: a digitiser's cover sheet, a dark card with a centred title in white capitals, a rule, an author line below it, and a small publisher logo at lower right.
page.notes: This is a digitiser's cover sheet, not a printed page of the book. Its title block ("CHRISTOPHORI WITTINCHII CONSENSUS VERITATIS IN SCRIPTURA DIVINA...") and author line ("Christoph Wittich") were added by the digitiser and are left out. The logo at lower right is also excluded. The page has no printed text of the book.
